en.text: Shares & Bonds

zh.text: 股票和債券

en.text: Who will receive the repayment first when a company liquidates?

zh.text: 當一間公司清盤時，誰會先獲得還款？

en.text: shareholders

zh.text: 股東

en.text: out of syllabus

zh.text: 超出課程範圍

en.text: directors

zh.text: 董事

en.text: debenture-holders

zh.text: 債券持有人

en.text: HKCEE 1990 Paper 2 Q14 (modified)

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1990 卷二 第 14 題（經修改）

en.text: On the liquidation of a public limited company, which of the following parties will get their money back before the others?

zh.text: 一間公眾有限公司清盤時，以下哪一個團體可較其他人優先收回屬於它的金錢？

en.text: the shareholders

zh.text: 股票持有人/股東

en.text: the debenture-holders

zh.text: 債券持有人

en.text: the government

zh.text: 政府

en.text: the employees of the company

zh.text: 僱員

en.text: HKCEE 1992 Paper 2 Q18

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1992 卷二 第 18 題

en.text: Mr Chan has purchased some shares in a public limited company. Which of the following statements is correct?

zh.text: 陳先生購買了一公眾有限公司的股票，下列哪一項是對的？

en.text: He cannot participate in the management of the firm.

zh.text: 他不能參與該公司的管理。

en.text: He will automatically receive a dividend from the company every year.

zh.text: 他每年都收取該公司的股息。

en.text: His personal accounts have to be disclosed to the public.

zh.text: 他須向公眾交代他的個人帳目。

en.text: His ownership in the company is freely transferable.

zh.text: 他可自由轉讓他對該公司的擁有權。

en.text: HKCEE 1993 Paper 2 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1993 卷二 第 3 題

en.text: From the viewpoint of a public limited company, which of the following is an advantage of issuing debentures over issuing shares to raise capital?

zh.text: 從公眾有限公司的角度看，籌集資金時，發行債券較發行股票為佳的一項原因是：

en.text: The company can raise more capital.

zh.text: 該公司可籌得較多資金。

en.text: The existing shareholders have a better control of ownership of the company.

zh.text: 現時的股東對該公司有較大的控制權。

en.text: The company can pay less to debenture holders than to shareholders when its profit is small.

zh.text: 當利潤微薄時，該公司付予債券持有人的金錢可較付予股東的為少。

en.text: It is easier to obtain more bank loans if the company issues more debentures rather than more shares.

zh.text: 發行更多債券較發行更多股票可使該公司較易獲得銀行貸款。

en.text: HKCEE 1993 Paper 2 Q7

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1993 卷二 第 7 題

en.text: What is the economic role of shareholders in a public limited company?

zh.text: 公眾有限公司的股東扮演什麼經濟角色？

en.text: preparing the company’s accounts

zh.text: 編寫公司帳目

en.text: making production decisions

zh.text: 作出生產的決定

en.text: bearing risk

zh.text: 承擔風險

en.text: sharing profits

zh.text: 分享利潤

en.text: HKCEE 1994 Paper 2 Q19

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1994 卷二 第 19 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about limited companies in Hong Kong is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪一項關於香港的有限公司的描述是正確的？

en.text: Shareholders and debenture holders have to bear unlimited liability.

zh.text: 股東和債券持有人都要承擔無限債償責任。

en.text: Issuing more debentures will increase the risk of being taken over.

zh.text: 發行更多債券會增加公司被收購的風險。

en.text: Shares and debentures of public limited companies are traded on the stock exchange.

zh.text: 公眾有限公司的股票和債券是在股票市場上買賣的。

en.text: Debenture holders can claim the company's assets prior to shareholders when the company goes bankrupt.

zh.text: 當公司破產時，債券持有人有權先於股東取得公司的資產。

en.text: HKCEE 2002 Paper 2 Q17

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2002 卷二 第 17 題

en.text: As a small investor, Calvin prefers to purchase the shares of a listed company rather than those of a private limited company in Hong Kong because

zh.text: 嘉芬是一位小額投資者，在香港的上市公司與私人有限公司之中，他會選擇購買前者的股票，因爲上市公司的

en.text: the accounts of a listed company have to be audited by certified accountants.

zh.text: 帳目須由註冊會計師核算。

en.text: there is a separation between ownership and management in a listed company.

zh.text: 擁有權與管理權是分離的。

en.text: the shares of a listed company are freely transferable on the stock market.

zh.text: 股票在股票市場上可自由轉讓。

en.text: the liability of the shareholders of a listed company is limited to their investment in the company.

zh.text: 股東的債償責任限於他們在該公司的投資額。

en.text: HKCEE 2002 Paper 2 Q18

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2002 卷二 第 18 題

en.text: From the viewpoint of investors, which of the following is an advantage of buying debentures over the purchase of shares?

zh.text: 從投資者的角度來看，下列哪一項是購買債券較購買普通股為優勝的地方？

en.text: The return of debentures is higher.

zh.text: 債券的回報較高。

en.text: Debentures can be sold on the stock exchange while shares cannot.

zh.text: 債券可以在證券交易所出售，而股票則不可以。

en.text: The market price of debentures is fixed.

zh.text: 債券的市價是固定的。

en.text: Debenture holders have a prior right to get their money back from the company if it liquidates.

zh.text: 若公司清盤，債券持有者享有優先權從公司取回他們的金錢。

en.text: HKCEE 2003 Paper 2 Q22

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2003 卷二 第 22 題

en.text: Which of the following descriptions about the shareholders and bondholders of a company is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪一項關於公司股東和公司債券持有人的描述是正確的？

en.text: Shareholders have a higher return than the bondholders.

zh.text: 股東所得的回報較債券持有人的爲高。

en.text: Bondholders have voting rights in the annual general meeting

zh.text: 債券持有人在股東週年大會上有投票權。

en.text: Shareholders are the creditors of the company.

zh.text: 股東是公司的債權人。

en.text: When the company winds up, the bondholders have a right to get the money back from the company in advance of its shareholders.

zh.text: 公司結束時，債券持有人較公司股東有先取回金錢的權利。

en.text: HKCEE 2005 Paper 2 Q21 (modified)

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2005 卷二 第 21 題（經修改）

en.text: From the viewpoint of the company, which of the following is an advantage of issuing shares over bonds to raise capital?

zh.text: 從公司的角度出發，下列哪一項是發行股票較發行債券以籌集資金更爲優勝之處？

en.text: The company can raise more capital.

zh.text: 該公司可籌得更多資金。

en.text: The company has the obligation to redeem the bonds but not the shares.

zh.text: 該公司有責任贖回債券，但不用贖回普通股股票。

en.text: The shares can be freely transferable on the stock market.

zh.text: 股票可在股市中自由轉讓。

en.text: The liability of the shareholders is confined to the amount they have invested in the company.

zh.text: 股東的債務責任只限於他們在該公司已投資的金額。

en.text: HKCEE 2006 Paper 2 Q22

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2006 卷二 第 22 題

en.text: From the viewpoint of the existing shareholders of a listed company, which of the following is an advantage of issuing bonds over shares to raise funds for future development?

zh.text: 從上市公司的現有股東的觀點出發，為了籌集資金作發展用途，下列哪一項可顯示發行債券較發行普通股股票為佳？

en.text: Their power of control over the company will not be diluted.

zh.text: 他們對該公司的控制權不會被攤薄。

en.text: The interest paid to the debenture holders is lower than the dividend.

zh.text: 支付予債券持有人的利息較股息低。

en.text: The company need not pay interest to the debenture holders when it incurs a loss.

zh.text: 該公司有虧損時，毋須支付利息予債券持有人。

en.text: The debenture holders have no right to sue the company, whereas the shareholders do have the right.

zh.text: 債券持有人無權控告該公司，但股東則有此權利。

en.text: HKCEE 2007 Paper 2 Q21

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2007 卷二 第 21 題

en.text: From the viewpoint of investors, which of the following is an advantage of buying shares over debentures?

zh.text: 從投資者角度看，下列哪項是購買普通股股票勝於購買債券之處？

en.text: The return of shares is higher than that of debentures.

zh.text: 普通股回報是高於債券回報的。

en.text: The market price of ordinary shares may increase while that of debentures is fixed.

zh.text: 普通股市價可上升，但債券市價是固定的。

en.text: Shareholders invest in the company at a lower risk than debenture holders.

zh.text: 普通股股東在該公司投資的風險低於債券持有人。

en.text: Shareholders have voting rights in annual general meetings while debenture holders do not.

zh.text: 普通股股東於周年大會上有投票權，而債券持有人則沒有。

en.text: HKCEE 2009 Paper 2 Q22 (modified)

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2009 卷二 第 22 題（經修改）

en.text: Which one of the following statements about the shareholders of a limited company is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項對一家有限公司股東的描述是正確的？

en.text: They are the creditors of the company.

zh.text: 他們是公司的債權人。

en.text: They have voting rights in the Board of Directors' meetings.

zh.text: 他們在董事局會議中有投票權。

en.text: They receive dividends at a rate that is not fixed.

zh.text: 他們收取股息，其股息率是不固定的。

en.text: They receive dividends at a higher rate than the interest of bondholders.

zh.text: 他們收取的股息率較債券持有人所得的利息率高。

en.text: HKCEE 2010 Paper 2 Q23 (modified)

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2010 卷二 第 23 題（經修改）

en.text: A public limited company plans to issue new bonds for expansion. For the existing shareholders, which of the following is an advantage of issuing bonds instead of shares?

zh.text: 某公眾有限公司計劃發行新的債券，以擴展業務。對現有的股東來說，下列哪項是發行債券而非股票的優點？

en.text: The accounts of the company need not be disclosed to the public.

zh.text: 毋須向公眾人士披露公司的帳目。

en.text: They have priority in getting back their capital if the company liquidates.

zh.text: 若公司清盤，他們會優先取回他們的資本。

en.text: The interest paid to the bondholders is lower than the dividend paid to the shareholders.

zh.text: 付予債券持有人的利息比付予股東的股息低。

en.text: Their power of control over the company will not be diluted.

zh.text: 他們對公司的控制權不會被削弱。

en.text: HKDSE 2014 Paper 1 Q7

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2014 卷一 第 7 題

en.text: The government launched the Silver Bond for Hong Kong residents aged 65 or above. Bondholders will be paid interest at a rate linked to inflation in Hong Kong, subject to a minimum rate of 2% per year. Bondholders may sell their bonds at original price to the government before maturity.

zh.text: 政府為 65 歲或以上的香港居民推出銀色債券。債券持有人會獲發利息，利率和本港通脹掛鉤，但年利率不會少於 2%。債券持有人可在到期前將其債券以原價賣給政府。

en.text: Which of the following statements about the Silver Bond is/are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪 (幾) 項有關銀色債券的陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) only

zh.text: 只有 (1)

en.text: (2) only

zh.text: 只有 (2)

en.text: (3) only

zh.text: 只有 (3)

en.text: The risk of holding the Silver Bond is lower than that of the shares of a listed company.

zh.text: 持有銀色債券的風險較持有上市公司股票的風險低。

en.text: The return of the Silver Bond would increase during inflation while the return of the shares of a listed company would not.

zh.text: 在通脹時銀色債券的回報會上升，而上市公司股票的回報則不會。

en.text: The interest received by Silver Bond holders is higher than the dividend received by the shareholders of a listed company.

zh.text: 銀色債券持有人收取的利息較上市公司股東收取的股息為高。

en.text: HKDSE 2017 Paper 1 Q6

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2017 卷一 第 6 題

en.text: Some small investors prefer debentures to shares. Which of the following is a possible reason for that?

zh.text: 一些小投資者偏好購買債券多於股票。下列哪項是可能的原因？

en.text: The return of debentures is generally higher than that of shares.

zh.text: 債券的回報一般高於股票的回報。

en.text: The price of shares may rise while that of debentures is fixed.

zh.text: 股票價格可能上升，而債券價格是固定的。

en.text: Shareholders need to spend time managing the company but debenture holders do not.

zh.text: 股東需要花時間管理公司，而債券持有人則不需要。

en.text: Companies have obligation to redeem debentures but they have no such obligation for shares.

zh.text: 公司有贖回債券的義務，卻沒有贖回股票的義務。

en.text: HKDSE 2020 Paper 1 Q4

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2020 卷一 第 4 題

en.text: Mr Wong decides to invest in the bonds of a listed company instead of the shares of that company. Which of the following is the
LEAST
likely reason behind Mr Wong’s investment decision above?

zh.text: 王先生決定投資某上市公司的債券，而非投資該公司的股票。下列哪項最不可能是王先生作上述投資決定背後的原因？

en.text: Mr Wong is optimistic about the business prospects of the company.

zh.text: 王先生對該公司的經營前景感到樂觀。

en.text: Mr Wong prefers a more stable return from investment.

zh.text: 王先生偏好較穩定的投資回報。

en.text: Mr Wong wants to have a lower risk of suffering from a loss.

zh.text: 王先生想有較低的蒙受損失的風險。

en.text: Mr Wong wants to have a higher priority in getting back his investment in case the company liquidates.

zh.text: 王先生想在該公司一旦清盤時，可較優先取回他的投資。

en.text: HKDSE 2025 Paper 1 Q10

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2025 卷一 第 10 題
